claim: Test whether supervising the canonical next-role delimiter with assistant content gives a byte-native response-only mouth a learned stop boundary without restoring user-content gradient.

views.probe: first eight SHA-ordered single-exchange training documents

model.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio

single_variable.negative_control: preserved payload-only O2 result: target exact followed by meaningless suffix
single_variable.treatment: assistant payload plus internal newlines and the next canonical line-start user-role delimiter; following user content remains masked

gates.mask_positive_control: internal assistant newlines and next user-role delimiter are selected; following user content is not selected
gates.single_document_positive_control: treatment exactly reproduces the registered assistant response after canonical turn parsing
gates.heldout_full_ce_descent: treatment final held-out full CE is below uniform CE and below its first registered held-out full CE
gates.prompt_conditioning: at least 6/8 non-empty and six normalized distinct replies
gates.target_recovery: at least 6/8 replies share the first 16 UTF-8 target bytes
gates.structural: all eight pass existing structural checks

promotion.303m_single_seed: allowed only after every gate passes and a separate preregistration

failure_policy.if_single_control_fails: record and do not run the 100-document treatment
failure_policy.if_treatment_fails: record and do not run 303M or couple IIT state
